faqs.question: What exactly is an AI receptionist?
faqs.answer: It's a voice AI employee that answers your business phone line, speaks naturally with callers, handles common questions, qualifies leads, books appointments when configured with a compatible booking system, and captures lead information so calls can be handled even when your team is busy or after hours.

faqs.question: What is the AI Receptionist?
faqs.answer: The AI Receptionist is the voice AI. It answers your business phone calls and has conversations with customers like a receptionist would. It can answer FAQs, qualify leads, capture customer information, book appointments when the appropriate customer system is configured, and transfer calls according to your rules.

faqs.question: Is the AI Receptionist the website chatbot?
faqs.answer: No. The AI Receptionist is the voice AI that handles phone calls. The AI Website Assistant is the separate website chat AI that handles conversations with visitors on a business website.

faqs.question: How much does it cost?
faqs.answer: There is a one-time setup fee, typically $300 to $1,000 depending on the complexity of the setup, plus a monthly subscription that covers hosting, voice minutes, and support. Exact pricing depends on the business and its requirements.

faqs.question: How can I get an exact quote?
faqs.answer: For an exact quote, submit your business details through the business details form at https://aixsystems.vercel.app/demo. You can also provide your email so the team can follow up personally.

faqs.question: How long does setup take?
faqs.answer: Most businesses are live within a week once AI X Systems receives the necessary business details, including services, hours, and FAQs.

faqs.question: Does it replace my staff?
faqs.answer: No. The AI handles repetitive front-desk work such as answering common questions, qualifying leads, and booking appointments when configured, allowing your team to focus on customers who need human attention.

faqs.question: Can it work with my existing calendar?
faqs.answer: The AI Receptionist can be configured to work with a customer's existing calendar or booking system. The exact setup depends on the tools the business already uses.

faqs.question: Can it work with my existing CRM?
faqs.answer: The AI Receptionist can be configured around different CRM and lead-management systems. The exact integration depends on the CRM the business uses and how that system is configured.

faqs.question: Can it work with my booking system?
faqs.answer: Yes, appointment booking can be configured around the customer's existing booking system when the system is compatible and properly connected. The exact setup depends on the tools the business uses.

faqs.question: Can it answer calls after business hours?
faqs.answer: Yes. The AI Receptionist can operate 24/7, including nights, weekends, and holidays.

faqs.question: Can the AI transfer calls to a real person?
faqs.answer: Yes. Call-transfer rules can be configured for situations such as urgent requests, specific customer types, or questions that require a human.

faqs.question: What happens if the AI cannot answer a question?
faqs.answer: Depending on the configured rules, the AI can take a message or transfer the call to a person. The relevant information can then be passed to the configured lead-management or notification system.

faqs.question: Can I try the AI Receptionist?
faqs.answer: Yes. AI X Systems has a live AI Receptionist demo on its website. The live demo lets you experience the voice AI and see how it handles a business conversation.

faqs.question: How do I try the demo?
faqs.answer: You can try the live AI Receptionist directly on the AI X Systems website using the live demo experience.

faqs.question: Do I need to book a demo call?
faqs.answer: No. You don't need to book a call just to try the live AI Receptionist demo. You can experience the voice AI directly on the website.

faqs.question: Can I get an AI Receptionist for my own business?
faqs.answer: Yes. If you want an AI Receptionist built for your business, AI X Systems first needs your business details so the system can be configured around your services, hours, FAQs, preferred call-handling process, and the tools your business uses.

faqs.question: Where do I submit my business details?
faqs.answer: You can submit your business details through the AI X Systems business details form at https://aixsystems.vercel.app/demo.

faqs.question: Is the business details form the live demo?
faqs.answer: No. They are separate. The live demo lets you experience the AI Receptionist voice AI. The business details form collects the information AI X Systems needs to build and customize an AI Receptionist for your business.

faqs.question: Do you offer phone or video discovery calls?
faqs.answer: No. AI X Systems no longer offers phone or video discovery calls. Customers who want to move forward can provide their email for a personal follow-up or submit their business details through the business details form.

general: Answer customer questions using all available business knowledge, not only the exact FAQ questions.
Understand different ways customers may phrase the same question and provide the relevant known answer.
Use the company information, services, service descriptions, features, pricing information, FAQs, integrations, demo information, and policies as the source of truth.
Do not require the customer's question to exactly match an FAQ before answering.
If the available business knowledge clearly answers the question, answer it directly and naturally.
If the available business knowledge does not contain enough information to answer confidently, do not guess, invent, or assume.
Never make up technical capabilities, integrations, pricing, discounts, guarantees, or services.
Never claim that a specific CRM, calendar, booking platform, phone system, or other software is supported unless that integration has been confirmed or configured.
Explain that CRM, booking, calendar, lead-management, and other integrations depend on the customer's existing tools and configuration.
For personalized pricing questions, provide the general setup range of $300–$1,000 plus a monthly subscription, then explain that exact pricing depends on the business and setup requirements.
For questions requiring confirmation from the team, collect the customer's email or direct them to the business details form.
If a customer asks something outside the business scope, politely explain that you can provide information about AI X Systems and its services, but do not invent an answer.
Keep answers concise, natural, professional, and conversational.
Do not overwhelm customers with unnecessary technical details unless they specifically ask.
